Confirmed. Now I have a complete, verified list of every file that names the `Role` type (import, annotation, type argument, or Record key).

- `src/types/member.ts` — defines `Role`; `ROLE_RANK: Record<Role, number>`
- `src/schemas/role.ts` — `const _roleParity: Role`
- `src/types/permission.ts` — `targetRole: Role`
- `src/types/feature-flag.ts` — `minRole: Role`, `role: Role | null`

- `src/lib/permissions.ts` — `ROLE_MATRIX: Record<PermissionAction, Role>`
- `src/lib/format.ts` — `Record<Role, string>`, `humanizeRole(role: Role)`
- `src/server/services/member-service.ts` — `assertLastOwnerRetained(..., nextRole: Role)`
- `src/server/repositories/member-repository.ts` — `role: Role` params
